architecture_summary: Modular React app. Pages in src/pages/. Reusable UI components in src/components/. CSS modules for styling. React Router v6 for navigation. No state management lib (use React context for shared state).

tickets.title: Onboarding steps widget page (src/pages/OnboardingStepsWidget.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch onboarding_steps_widget screen to React. Extract reusable StepIndicator component. Use CSS modules for styling. Match design pixel-perfect.
acceptance_criteria: StepIndicator component reusable, accept props: currentStep, totalSteps, labels
Styling match Stitch design (colors, spacing, typography)

tickets.title: Onboarding web view with fixed tokens page (src/pages/OnboardingWebView.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch onboarding_steps_web_view_fixed_tokens screen. Embed web view for token display. Extract TokenDisplay component. CSS modules for styling.
acceptance_criteria: TokenDisplay component accept props: tokens (array of {symbol, value, icon})
Web view iframe sandboxed, src from config

tickets.title: Button showcase web view page (src/pages/ButtonShowcaseWebView.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch button_showcase_web_view_final screen. Extract reusable Button component. CSS modules for styling. Support variants: primary, secondary, disabled, loading.
acceptance_criteria: Button component accept props: variant, disabled, loading, onClick, children
Styling match Stitch design (hover, active, focus states)
Loading state show spinner, disable interaction

tickets.title: Button showcase mobile page (src/pages/ButtonShowcaseMobile.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch button_showcase_mobile screen. Reuse Button component from TASK-003. CSS modules for mobile-specific styling. Ensure touch targets meet WCAG 2.1 AA.

tickets.title: Shared UI components and design tokens (src/components/, src/styles/)
tickets.description: Extract shared design tokens (colors, spacing, typography). Create shared UI components: Spinner, Card. CSS variables for theming. Document usage in README.md.
acceptance_criteria: Design tokens match Stitch design system
Spinner component accept props: size, color
Card component accept props: children, padding, elevation

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Create app shell. Add navigation bar. Set up React Router v6. Routes: /onboarding-steps, /onboarding-web-view, /button-showcase-web, /button-showcase-mobile. Lazy load pages. 404 fallback.
acceptance_criteria: 404 page show when route not found
